propositions: Pydantic-AI 1.107.2 emits PydanticAIDeprecationWarning when rebar constructs inferred or legacy-explicit openai: targets, signaling v2 will reinterpret the prefix from Chat Completions to Responses
rebar's _pai_model and model_classes._resolve_target preserve or emit the ambiguous openai: qualifier instead of the explicit openai-chat: prefix
ProviderSession registers custom base URL and per-candidate endpoint builders only on the legacy openai provider name, causing openai-chat: targets to fall back to public API endpoints

Normalizing all inferred, configured, and legacy-explicit OpenAI targets to openai-chat: eliminates the deprecation warning while preserving existing Chat Completions wire semantics and endpoint injection
The repair requires updates to anthropic_model.py, model_classes.py, providers.py, and documentation examples to treat openai and openai-chat as compatible spellings for provider resolution
